question: Nursing informatics is a mix of three main fields. Which ones are they?

options.C: Social science, psychology, and public health
options.D: Nursing science, computer science, and information science

explanation: You've got this! Nursing informatics simply blends nursing practice with computer technology and information management to keep health data organized. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h1)

question: What is the main goal of using nursing informatics in a healthcare setting?

options.A: Eliminate the need for verbal shift handovers entirely
options.B: Manage and communicate health data and knowledge
options.C: Replace clinical judgment with automated computer programs
options.D: Increase the speed of physical drug administration

explanation: Think of informatics as a helpful assistant. Its goal is to help us organize and share health information so we can make better decisions for our patients. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h1)

question: Scanning a patient's wristband before giving out drugs is an example of what type of informatics?
explanation: Spot on! Because this tool is used right at the bedside during direct patient care, we call it clinical nursing informatics. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h2)

question: Which of these is a key tool used in clinical nursing informatics?
explanation: Electronic health records (EHRs) are the digital charts nurses use every day on the ward to track and document patient care. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h2)

question: Why do nurse managers and ward leaders rely heavily on administrative informatics systems?

options.A: To teach undergraduate nursing students clinical procedures
options.B: To optimize ward staffing and track quality indicators
options.C: To publish academic research articles in global journals
options.D: To diagnose complex medical conditions in emergency patients

explanation: Ward managers aren't diagnosing illnesses with these tools; instead, they use them to arrange duty rosters, manage budgets, and track hospital standards. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h3)

question: Which task is best handled using nursing administration informatics?

options.A: Generating staff duty rosters and duty schedules
options.B: Calculating intravenous drug infusion flow rates
options.C: Providing discharge lifestyle advice to clients

explanation: Administrative informatics is all about keeping the hospital running smoothly behind the scenes, like organizing shift duties and staff schedules. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h3)

question: Virtual patient simulations used in your nursing school labs fall under which informatics branch?
explanation: Since it's a tool designed specifically to help students learn and practice clinical skills, it belongs to nursing education informatics! [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h4)

question: How do Learning Management Systems (LMS) mostly help nursing educators?

options.A: By organizing course content and tracking student assessments
options.B: By managing hospital payroll and employee benefits
options.C: By diagnosing patient ailments in clinical practice
options.D: By storing electronic medical records of ward patients

explanation: Think of the portal you use to check your assignments or notes—that's an LMS helping educators organize classes and track student progress. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h4)

question: What is the main purpose of nursing research informatics?

options.A: To schedule nursing shifts on hospital wards
options.B: To track patient billing and health insurance
options.C: To collect and analyze data for scientific studies
options.D: To teach basic anatomy to first-year students

explanation: Research informatics is all about gathering and making sense of data so nurses can discover new, evidence-based ways to improve care. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h5)

question: Why is secure electronic data capture so important when conducting nursing research?

options.A: It protects participant confidentiality and ensures data accuracy
options.B: It speeds up medication administration times on the ward
options.C: It eliminates the need for any statistical data analysis
options.D: It replaces the need for institutional ethical approval

explanation: Keeping research data secure is vital to protect people's privacy and ensure our study results are true and reliable. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h5)

question: Who is the main person targeted by consumer health informatics?

options.C: The patient or the general public

explanation: Consumer health informatics is designed for everyday people, helping them understand and track their own health using apps and gadgets. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h6)

question: A patient asks you about a health tracking app on their smartphone. This situation is an example of...
explanation: Any digital health tool that regular patients use to manage their personal wellness falls right under consumer health informatics. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h6)

question: What is a major challenge slowing down the growth of nursing informatics in Nigeria?

options.A: The absence of any patients requiring digital records
options.B: Unstable power supply and limited internet infrastructure
options.C: A complete lack of interest from registered nurses
options.D: Excessive availability of advanced computer hardware

explanation: As we often experience firsthand, erratic electricity and poor internet connectivity remain major hurdles for digital health in Nigeria. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h7)

question: Which of these is NOT a benefit of bringing nursing informatics into healthcare?

options.A: Improving communication across multidisciplinary care teams
options.B: Streamlining hospital administrative and staffing workflows
options.C: Increasing the frequency of medication transcription errors
options.D: Enhancing the accessibility of patient health records

explanation: Informatics is meant to reduce errors through smart alerts and clear digital records, not cause more mistakes! [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h7)
